title: Directed Graph
body:
A [[Graph]] whose edges have a direction: an edge from $u$ to $v$ does not imply one from
$v$ to $u$. Follow-relationships, web links, task dependencies, and one-way streets are all
directed.

The representation changes accordingly: an [[Adjacency Matrix]] for a directed graph is no
longer symmetric, and an [[Adjacency List]] stores each edge once, in the source vertex's
list. Each vertex now has an in-degree and an out-degree rather than a single degree
(see [[Vertices]]).
